corrections.corrected_statement: For a 3-speed transmission, the manual generally describes third gear for speeds above 25 miles per hour.
corrections.note: The complete rule is stated on page 45, not page 44.

corrections.corrected_statement: A five sided sign means you are in a school zone and you must slow to fifteen miles per hour during recess, when children are going to or leaving school, from one half hour before the start of the school day to one half hour after the end of the school day, or when school speed limit signs are flashing during school opening or closing hours.
corrections.note: Page states a school zone speed rule, not a pedestrian symbol above an arrow.

corrections.corrected_statement: If wheels leave the pavement, remain calm, slow gradually and hold the wheel firmly.

Pickup passengers younger than 19 must use the passenger compartment, except qualifying work or training travel, licensed-hunter travel to or from hunting, parade participation, or a belted manufacturer-installed outside seat.
corrections.note: Statement is correct but the final exception is printed on page 120, not page 119.
